'''Elora daughter of [[Amar]] daughter of [[Coura]]''' was an [[Ogier]] author that lived in the early days of [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall|Artur Hawkwing's]] reign.

==History==
Elora was the author of the book ''[[Men of Fire and Women of Air]]'', which concerns [[Aes Sedai]] dealing with men who can channel. [[Loial]] tells [[Perrin Aybara]] of Elora and [[Ledar]]'s works in relation to what Aes Sedai might do in regards to [[Rand al'Thor]].
